extraction.Name: Edward Stover
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee but accepted it for the reason that he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land and get nothing for it
extraction.Buyer: Audiss Bros. of Martin, So. Dak. for $2800.00, and they were to pay the back taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so he had to sell the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: makes his living by common labor, his income averaging $400.00 a year
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, not in good health; is broke, having no land, no home and nothing; has a wife and seven minor children depending on him for support; has received no aid from the State, County or Government since he was granted a patent to his land; document sworn November 28, 1928, in Shannon County, South Dakota
